title: Semantic Regions, Interactables & Governed Triggers
objective: Make already-governed cells, cell areas, rooms, named zones and gridless regions first-class interaction surfaces and bind authorized entry/exit/presence/interact/state-change signals to versioned, idempotent owner-operation proposals for Encounter, Hazard, Item, Objective, Door, Transition, Portal and other canonical owner domains without creating a duplicate trigger, rules or ownership ledger.

persistence.reason: ISE-04 projects existing Scene regions and owner-domain objects and emits versioned/idempotent operation proposals. It does not create a parallel region, interactable, trigger, rule or runtime-state ledger.

preserved_boundaries: ISE-01..03 remain completed_verified with no reopened implementation authority.
Scene regions and owner-domain objects remain canonical; ISE-04 projections never become duplicate ownership records.
Entry/exit/presence/interact/state-change signals can only produce governed owner-operation proposals; they cannot commit canonical state.
Permissions, consent, GM adjudication, expected-version, idempotency and Action/Event or owning-domain validation remain mandatory.
Hidden/GM-only regions, interactables, trigger metadata and protected cardinality are removed before ISE-04 receives inputs.
Trigger semantics are owner/profile-authored; ISE-04 does not invent universal proximity, collision, encounter, hazard, objective, portal or interaction rules.
Migration 0022 remains unreserved because no new durable owner record is needed.
ISE-05+ feature work, paid provider activation, unauthorized media redistribution, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: Validate and merge this exact ISE-04 governed-start control-plane state. If green, create the registered application branch at 81b1c640330ea80c9f9715d5c43130eb0f144fbe, implement one bounded ISE-04 profile, and execute exact-head cross-platform validation through merge and closeout if no genuine blocker survives.
